import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.WholePositiveCanonicalFields
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.CanonicalWholePositiveRootMatching
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.CanonicalWholeNegativeBoundary
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.AdjugateInversePrincipalField
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.AdjugatePrincipalFiniteJets
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.FiniteFullJetBoundary

/-!
# Actual positive principal jets at a negative neighbor

The genuine inverse-chart field equals its forward adjugate formula.
The existing coordinate and height matching therefore transfers full
principal jets from the actual neighboring negative transport. No
coefficient matching or vanishing remainder is an input.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

theorem wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients_eq_reverse
    (A : SymmetricCoefficients) (τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (Q : PolarPoint → ℝ) :
    wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients A τ σ Q =
      reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A τ σ Q := by
  have hh : wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q = (fun y : PolarPoint => (Q (σ y))⁻¹) := by
    funext y
    rfl
  simp only [wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients, reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients,
    hh, one_div]

theorem wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficient_component_eq_adjugate
    (A : SymmetricCoefficients) {τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint}
    {Q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r c d : ℝ}
    (H : WholePositiveChartGeometry σ τ (wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q) l r c d)
    (i : Fin 3) :
    canonicalCoefficientComponent i (wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients A τ σ Q) =
      canonicalCoefficientComponent i (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A τ Q) := by
  funext p
  have hQ : 0 < (Q p)⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [wholePositiveChartHeight, H.right_inverse p] using
      H.height_positive (τ p)
  have hi : σ ∘ τ =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall H.right_inverse
  have he := reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients_eq_adjugate A
    (F := τ) (G := σ) (h := Q) (x := p)
    (H.inverse_smooth.differentiable (by simp) p)
    (H.chart_smooth.differentiable (by simp) (τ p)) hi (inv_pos.mp hQ).ne'
  rw [wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients_eq_reverse]
  simp only [canonicalCoefficientComponent, ite_apply]
  split_ifs
  · exact he.1
  · exact he.2.1
  · exact he.2.2

/-- This consumes the already constructed coordinate and height jets;
the output concerns the actual inverse-chart coefficient function. -/
theorem finiteFullJetMatch_wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficient
    {A : SymmetricCoefficients} {T τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint}
    {q Q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {p : PolarPoint} {n : ℕ} {l r c d : ℝ}
    (H : WholePositiveChartGeometry σ τ (wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q) l r c d)
    (hTτ : FiniteFullJetMatch (n + 1) p T τ)
    (hqQ : FiniteFullJetMatch n p q Q)
    (ha : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.a (T p)) (hb : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.b (T p))
    (hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.c (T p))
    (hq : q p ≠ 0) (hJ : planeJacobian T p ≠ 0) (i : Fin 3) :
    FiniteFullJetMatch n p
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent i (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A T q))
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent i (wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients A τ σ Q)) := by
  rw [wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficient_component_eq_adjugate A H i]
  exact finiteFullJetMatch_adjugatePrincipal hTτ hqQ ha hb hc hq hJ i

/-- The true negative index and the coefficient evaluation point come
from the actual atlas and its closed-component range. -/
theorem n04Coordinates_wholePositivePrincipal_negative_root_jets
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss n : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε) (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1)
    {i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w)}
    (j : ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side)
    {τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {Q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c d J H : ℝ}
    (hm : WholePositiveTransportMatching n
      (fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e) z)
      (fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e) z)
      τ σ Q (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) c d J H)
    (m : ℕ) (side : Bool)
    (hadj : n04PositiveEndpoint i (!side) = (if side then C.right m else C.left m))
    (θ : ℝ) (v : Fin 3) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
    FiniteFullJetMatch n (if side then C.right m else C.left m, θ)
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent v (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients
        (L.coefficients z) (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m)
        (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z m)))
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent v (wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients
        (L.coefficients z) τ σ Q)) := by
  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
  let p : PolarPoint := (if side then C.right m else C.left m, θ)
  have hends := hN.1.1.2.2.2.1.1 m
  have hp : p ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) := by
    refine ⟨?_, mem_univ _⟩
    cases side
    · exact ⟨le_rfl, hends.2.1.le⟩
    · exact ⟨hends.2.1.le, le_rfl⟩
  have hreg := canonicalWholeNegativeTransport_closed_regular
    hT hS hN hfield e hz hs m (p := p) hp
  have hj := wholePositiveTransportMatching_negative_root_jets hN.1.1 j hm
  have hTτ : FiniteFullJetMatch (n + 1) p
      (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m) τ :=
    ⟨hreg.1, hm.geometry.smooth.contDiffAt,
      fun k hk => (hj m side hadj).1 θ k hk⟩
  have hqQ : FiniteFullJetMatch n p
      (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z m) Q :=
    ⟨hreg.2.1, hm.height_smooth.contDiffAt,
      fun k hk => (hj m side hadj).2 θ k hk⟩
  have hJ : planeJacobian (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m) p ≠ 0 := by
    have hpos : 0 < planeJacobian (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m) p := by
      simpa only [planeJacobian, hTτ.fderiv.value] using hm.geometry.jacobian_positive p
    exact hpos.ne'
  have himage := canonicalWholeNegativeTransport_mapsTo_closed
    hT hS hN hfield e hz hs m (x := p) hp
  have hcore : canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m p ∈ annularOpen D :=
    ⟨⟨hends.1.trans_le himage.1.1, himage.1.2.trans_lt hends.2.2⟩, mem_univ _⟩
  have hnhds : annularOpen D ∈ 𝓝 (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m p) :=
    (isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds hcore
  have hA := hfield.smooth_coefficients z hz hs
  exact finiteFullJetMatch_wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficient
    (wholePositiveChartGeometry_of_matching hm) hTτ hqQ
    (hA.1.contDiffAt hnhds) (hA.2.1.contDiffAt hnhds) (hA.2.2.contDiffAt hnhds)
    hreg.2.2.ne' hJ v

theorem radialBoundaryJet_sub_eq_zero_of_finiteFullJetMatch
    {f g : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c θ : ℝ} {n k : ℕ}
    (h : FiniteFullJetMatch n (c, θ) f g) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    radialBoundaryJet (fun p => f p - g p) c k θ = 0 := by
  have hl : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun r : ℝ => (r, θ)) c :=
    contDiffAt_id.prodMk contDiffAt_const
  have hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun r : ℝ => f (r, θ)) c :=
    h.left_smooth.comp c hl
  have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun r : ℝ => g (r, θ)) c :=
    h.right_smooth.comp c hl
  change iteratedDeriv k (fun r : ℝ => f (r, θ) - g (r, θ)) c = 0
  rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_sub
    (hf.of_le (show (k : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞ by simp))
    (hg.of_le (show (k : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞ by simp))]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (radialBoundaryJet_eq_of_finiteFullJetMatch h hk)

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.WholeCanonicalAtlasData

/-!
# The retained cuts of the whole-component atlas

The new enumeration changes neither physical negative half nor cut
curve. Reindex the existing cut geometry and transmission identities
through that one enumeration, keeping the same inverse and height.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open scoped ContDiff
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements

variable {D : ReferenceData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
  (C : NonlinearGeometryData S) (L : ReturnCorrectionData S) (K : CanonicalData S)
  (e : ℕ ≃ N04WholePieceIndex D)
  (cell : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℕ)
  (F G : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
    N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
  (Q : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
    N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
  (N : Set ℝ) {base : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_cutGeometry
    (hcut : CanonicalCutGeometry S C K base ε) :
    CanonicalCutGeometry S C
      (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N) base ε := by
  constructor
  · intro m
    have h := hcut.1 m
    simpa only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
      n04WholeCutPair, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, n04WholePiecePositive,
      Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true, h.1, h.2.1] using h
  · intro z hz hs m
    have h := hcut.2 z hz hs m
    dsimp only [CanonicalCurrentCutPair, canonicalCutPoint] at h ⊢
    simpa only [physicalPieceOpen, n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
      n04WholeCutPair, Equiv.apply_symm_apply,
      Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true] using h

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_transmission
    (htrans : ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, stateSector S z.1 →
      ∀ u : PolarPoint → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ u → ∀ m θ,
        let Wl := canonicalHeight S K z (K.cutPair m).1 u
        let Wr := canonicalHeight S K z (K.cutPair m).2 u
        Wr (K.cutRadius m, θ) = Wl (K.cutRadius m, θ) ∧
          radialPartial Wr (K.cutRadius m, θ) =
            -radialPartial Wl (K.cutRadius m, θ) -
              Wl (K.cutRadius m, θ) / (2 * K.cutRadius m))
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (u : PolarPoint → ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u)
    (m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N
    let Wl := canonicalHeight S W z (W.cutPair m).1 u
    let Wr := canonicalHeight S W z (W.cutPair m).2 u
    Wr (W.cutRadius m, θ) = Wl (W.cutRadius m, θ) ∧
      radialPartial Wr (W.cutRadius m, θ) =
        -radialPartial Wl (W.cutRadius m, θ) -
          Wl (W.cutRadius m, θ) / (2 * W.cutRadius m) := by
  have h := htrans z hz hs u hu m θ
  dsimp only [canonicalHeight] at h ⊢
  simpa only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
    n04WholeCutPair, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true] using h

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.WholeCanonicalAtlasCurrentPartition
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.N04PositiveNormalizationBuffer

/-!
# The actual reference partition and buffered normalization inclusion

The old optical cut supplies the exact negative reference radii. Whole
positive components supply the remaining intervals. Their already proved
countable reference exception gives the radial null-set partition.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set MeasureTheory
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements

variable {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
  {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
  {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
  (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
  (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
  (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
  (e₀ : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D) (e : ℕ ≃ N04WholePieceIndex D)
  (cell : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℕ)
  (F G : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
    N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
  (Q : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
    N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
  (N : Set ℝ)

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_reference_radii (m : ℕ) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L
      (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀) e cell F G Q N
    W.physicalLeft m = n04WholePieceLeft C (n04bActualReferenceCut hN) (e m) ∧
      W.physicalRight m = n04WholePieceRight C (n04bActualReferenceCut hN) (e m) := by
  cases hi : e m with
  | inl j =>
      rcases j with ⟨j, side⟩
      cases side <;> simp only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
        n04bActualTypedAtlas, n04bTypedAtlasData, n04bCanonicalOperatorData,
        n04bReferenceMetadata, n04bReferencePieces, n04bReferenceTypedLeft,
        n04bReferenceTypedRight, n04WholePieceLeft, n04WholePieceRight, hi,
        Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true, and_self]
  | inr i =>
      simp only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
        n04WholePieceLeft, n04WholePieceRight, hi, and_self]

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_referencePartition :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L
      (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀) e cell F G Q N
    ∃ E : Set ℝ, volume E = 0 ∧ ∀ r ∈ Ioo D.a D.b \ E,
      ∃! m, r ∈ Ioo (W.physicalLeft m) (W.physicalRight m) := by
  have hD := n04b_profileGeometry_of_through03 hN
  have hf : Continuous (deriv D.w) := hD.2.2.1.1.continuous_deriv (by simp)
  have hC : controlGeometryConditions D S C := hN.1.1.2.2.2.1
  have hcut : ∀ m, n04bActualReferenceCut hN m ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) :=
    n04bActualReferenceCut_mem hN
  refine ⟨n04WholePieceExceptional D (n04bActualReferenceCut hN),
    (n04WholePieceExceptional_countable hD).measure_zero volume, ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hu⟩ := n04WholePiece_cover hf hC hcut hr
  refine ⟨e.symm i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hrad := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_reference_radii
      hT hS hN hfield e₀ e cell F G Q N (e.symm i)
    dsimp only
    rw [hrad.1, hrad.2, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hi
  · intro n hn
    apply e.injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    apply hu
    have hrad := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_reference_radii
      hT hS hN hfield e₀ e cell F G Q N n
    dsimp only at hn
    rwa [hrad.1, hrad.2] at hn

theorem n04PositiveNormalizationBuffer_region_subset_actualNormalization
    {U : Set ℝ} (B : N04PositiveNormalizationBuffer D.a D.b (deriv D.w) U)
    (hf : Continuous (deriv D.w)) :
    B.region ⊆ (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀).normalizationRegion := by
  change B.region ⊆ n04bNormalizationRegion D
  have hclosed : closure {r : ℝ | deriv D.w r < 0} ⊆ {r : ℝ | deriv D.w r ≤ 0} :=
    closure_minimal (by
      intro x hx
      change deriv D.w x ≤ 0
      exact (show deriv D.w x < 0 from hx).le) (isClosed_le hf continuous_const)
  intro r hr
  exact fun hneg => (not_le_of_gt (B.region_subset_positive hf hr).2) (hclosed hneg)

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.WholeCanonicalAtlasData
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.ActualNegativePrincipalDensity

/-!
# Negative principal density on the actual whole atlas

Every stored negative half is contained in its genuine full negative
component. The actual root-coordinate density computation therefore
applies to its stored chart and height, using the old enumeration only
to identify the same constructed functions.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_negativePrincipalDensity
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (e₀ : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D) (e : ℕ ≃ N04WholePieceIndex D)
    (cell : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℕ)
    (F G : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (Q : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (N : Set ℝ)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀)
      e cell F G Q N).positive m = false)
    (x : PolarPoint) (hx : x ∈ physicalPieceOpen S
      (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀)
        e cell F G Q N) z m) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀)
      e cell F G Q N
    (coordinatePrincipalDensity (L.coefficients z) (W.chart z m) (W.height z m)).a x = 1 ∧
      (coordinatePrincipalDensity (L.coefficients z) (W.chart z m) (W.height z m)).b x = 0 ∧
      (coordinatePrincipalDensity (L.coefficients z) (W.chart z m) (W.height z m)).c x =
        -(W.chart z m x).1 := by
  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀
  cases hi : e m with
  | inl j =>
      let k := if j.2 then (K.cutPair j.1).2 else (K.cutPair j.1).1
      have hk : e₀ k = .inl j := by
        rcases j with ⟨j, side⟩
        cases side <;> simp only [k, K, n04bActualTypedAtlas,
          n04bTypedAtlasData_cutPair, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true,
          Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      rcases n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_negative_fields
        C L K e cell F G Q N z m j hi with
        ⟨hl, hr, hpl, hpr, hd, hc, hpos, hF, hG, hh, hco, hV⟩
      have hxold : x ∈ physicalPieceOpen S K z k := by
        rw [← hd]
        exact hx
      have hxraw : x ∈ n04bTypedPhysicalDomain (D := D) C
          (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z) (.inl j) := by
        simpa only [K, n04bActualTypedAtlas,
          n04bTypedAtlasData_physicalPieceOpen, hk] using hxold
      have hxfull := n04b_typed_negative_domain_subset j hxraw
      have h := n04Coordinates_actualAtlas_negativePrincipalDensity
        hT hS hN hfield e₀ hz hs k j.1 j.2 hk hxfull
      have hchart :
          (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N).chart z m =
            K.chart z k := hF
      have hheight :
          (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N).height z m =
            K.height z k := hh
      change (coordinatePrincipalDensity (L.coefficients z)
          ((n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N).chart z m)
          ((n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N).height z m)).a x = 1 ∧
        (coordinatePrincipalDensity (L.coefficients z)
          ((n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N).chart z m)
          ((n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N).height z m)).b x = 0 ∧
        (coordinatePrincipalDensity (L.coefficients z)
          ((n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N).chart z m)
          ((n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N).height z m)).c x =
            -((n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N).chart z m x).1
      rw [hchart, hheight]
      exact h
  | inr i =>
      simp only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
        hi, n04WholePiecePositive, Bool.true_eq_false] at hm

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.WholeCanonicalAtlasData
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.N04bActualAtlasCuts
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.N04bGeometricCompletion

/-!
# Actual operator fields of the whole-component atlas

The retained negative fields and the inserted positive fields both use
the same inverse-coordinate formulas. Establish that fact on the one
stored record, then apply the full coordinate operator identity with
physical regularity at its actual inverse image.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open scoped ContDiff
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements ContinuousFlexibility.Blueprint

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_operatorFields
    {D : ReferenceData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    (C : NonlinearGeometryData S) (L : ReturnCorrectionData S) (K : CanonicalData S)
    (e : ℕ ≃ N04WholePieceIndex D)
    (cell : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℕ)
    (F G : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (Q : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (N : Set ℝ) (hcut : CanonicalReferenceCutPairs S C K)
    (hfields : ∀ z m,
      K.coefficients z m = inverseChartPrincipalCoefficients (L.coefficients z)
        (K.chart z m) (K.inverseChart z m) (K.height z m) ∧
      ∀ p, K.potential z m p = (if K.positive m then -1 else (1 : ℝ)) *
        inverseChartPotential (L.coefficients z)
          (K.chart z m) (K.inverseChart z m) (K.height z m) p)
    (z : AnnularState S × ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N
    W.coefficients z m = inverseChartPrincipalCoefficients (L.coefficients z)
      (W.chart z m) (W.inverseChart z m) (W.height z m) ∧
      ∀ p, W.potential z m p = (if W.positive m then -1 else (1 : ℝ)) *
        inverseChartPotential (L.coefficients z)
          (W.chart z m) (W.inverseChart z m) (W.height z m) p := by
  dsimp only
  cases hi : e m with
  | inl j =>
      let k := if j.2 then (K.cutPair j.1).2 else (K.cutPair j.1).1
      have hneg : K.positive k = false := by
        rcases j with ⟨j, side⟩
        cases side
        · exact (hcut j).1
        · exact (hcut j).2.1
      simpa only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision, hi,
        n04WholePiecePositive, hneg, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false] using hfields z k
  | inr i =>
      simp only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision, hi,
        n04WholePiecePositive, ite_true, wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients,
        wholePositiveCanonicalPotential, neg_one_mul]
      exact ⟨True.intro, fun _ => True.intro⟩

variable {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
  {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
  {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
  (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
  (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
  (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
  (e₀ : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D) (e : ℕ ≃ N04WholePieceIndex D)
  (cell : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℕ)
  (F G : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
    N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
  (Q : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
    N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
  (N : Set ℝ)

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_operatorFields
    (z : AnnularState S × ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀)
      e cell F G Q N
    W.coefficients z m = inverseChartPrincipalCoefficients (L.coefficients z)
      (W.chart z m) (W.inverseChart z m) (W.height z m) ∧
      ∀ p, W.potential z m p = (if W.positive m then -1 else (1 : ℝ)) *
        inverseChartPotential (L.coefficients z)
          (W.chart z m) (W.inverseChart z m) (W.height z m) p := by
  apply n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_operatorFields C L
    (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀) e cell F G Q N
    (n04bActualTypedAtlas_cutGeometry hT hS hN hfield e₀).1
  intro z m
  exact ⟨rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_operator
    (hA : CanonicalGeometry D S C
      (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀)
        e cell F G Q N) base ε)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (m : ℕ) (u : PolarPoint → ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u)
    (p : PolarPoint) (hp : p ∈ canonicalOpen S
      (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀)
        e cell F G Q N) m) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀)
      e cell F G Q N
    canonicalOperator S W L z m u p =
      (if W.positive m then -1 else (1 : ℝ)) *
        divergenceOperator (W.coefficients z m) u p + W.potential z m p * u p := by
  have hx := (hA.charts z hz hs m).2.1 hp
  obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩ := n04b_field_contDiffAt_on_piece hA hfield hz hs m hx
  have hop := n04b_canonicalOperator_explicit_fields hA hz hs m hp ha hb hc u hu
  have hf := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_operatorFields
    hT hS hN hfield e₀ e cell F G Q N z m
  rw [← hf.1, ← hf.2 p] at hop
  exact hop
